title.en: MALACAÑANG PMS LIBRARY BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES MFN ID 119,35 DESIGNATING CALAMBA CITY AS REGIONAL CENTER OF REGION IV-A (CALABARZON)

text.en:
Calamba City is hereby designated as the regional center of
Region IV-A (CALABARZON).

The Regional Development Council of Region IV-A shall immediately
undertake necessary steps for the site development of the CALABARZON regional center
in Calamba City.

All national line agencies shall locate their regional offices in Calamba
City as soon as possible and provide the necessary budgetary and other requirements
for this purpose.

All orders, rules, regulations and issuances, or parts thereof, which are
inconsistent with this Executive Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 28th day of October
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Three.
, in the year of
BYE Resent G. Ram
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretar
POMA Hologram • 22636
